site.audience: general audience interested in educational conferences and talks

brief.title: IdeaForum — Page Not Found
brief.one_liner: A 404 error page for an educational conference and talks platform, guiding users back to available content.
brief.goal: Provide a clear, branded 404 error page that helps users navigate back to the main site or search for the content they were looking for.

pages.objective: Inform the user that the requested page was not found and provide helpful navigation options including search and links to the homepage and help center.

interactions.trigger: User types a query into the search input field and clicks the search icon
interactions.expected: A search is initiated and the user is taken to search results for their query

interactions.trigger: User clicks Manage Preferences in the cookie consent banner
interactions.expected: A modal or panel opens allowing the user to configure cookie and privacy preferences

expected_content: Perhaps we can help you find the content you're looking for:
data_display.description: Error message content displayed on the 404 page including the apology, helpful suggestion, error code, and navigation links
